answer: What survives to the lagoon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Work waits on the mirror until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the terrace of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
